mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, con.Con_Name as conName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, c1.C_Name_History as rwFlowCNameHistory, c1.C_Name as rwFlowCName, c1.C_Abbreviation as rwFlowCAbbName, d.D_Name as dName, rwi.Rwi_Name as rwiName, rwi.Rwi_Level as rwiLevel, u.U_Name as rwPmName, rwi.Rwi_Desc as rwiDesc, rwi.Rwi_Problem as rwiProblem, mn.* from Risk_Warn mn left join Risk_Warn_Index rwi on mn.Rwi_Id=rwi.Rwi_Id left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id=pro.P_ID left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id=con.Con_Id left join Sec_Info sec on mn.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Rw_Flow_C_Id=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Department d on mn.D_Id=d.D_Id left join SYS_User u on mn.Rw_Pm_Id=u.U_Id where mn.Rw_ID=#{rwId}

select max(rwi.Rwi_Name) as "rwiName", count(distinct mn.Rw_Id) as "warnCount" from Risk_Warn mn left join Risk_Warn_Index rwi on mn.Rwi_Id = rwi.Rwi_Id left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join SYS_User u1 on mn.Rw_Handle_Uid = u1.U_Id left join SYS_File sf on mn.Rw_From = sf.FileID
left join Outline_Project_Risk opr on opr.Risk_Id = mn.Rwi_Id
${params.authSql}
and rwi.Rwi_Desc like concat('%', #{params.rwiDesc}, '%')
and rwi.Rwi_Problem like concat('%', #{params.rwiProblem}, '%')
group by mn.Rwi_Id order by count(distinct mn.Rw_Id) desc, mn.Rwi_Id asc
